== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Trackless Sea is a massive, endless ocean located to the north of the [[Blackflame Empire]]. It is recognized as the largest known body of water, covering approximately half of the world's surface. The ocean is home to various threats, including sea monsters, walking sharks, and vicious water-spirits. While some stretches of the sea are uninhabited, other regions contain their own distinct nations and cities. The [[Kotai clan]] is responsible for manning the defensive wall that protects the empire from various ocean tribes seeking to seize land. Within the sea, there are underwater labyrinths and specialized locations such as [[Ghostwater]], a [[pocket world]] created by the [[Monarch]] [[Northstrider]] that contains a research facility. The area is also subject to extreme environmental phenomena, including storms filled with liquid lightning and the presence of [[storm-dragons]]. Additionally, the sea has been impacted by massive entities like the [[Wandering Titan]] and the [[Dreadgod]].}}
